rows.question: How many depository libraries did GPO staff visit in FY 2018?
rows.answer: In FY 2018, GPO staff visited 166 depository libraries in 25 states [1][4].

rows.question: What new digital system replaced FDsys, and when was it fully deployed?
rows.answer: The new digital system is govinfo (www.govinfo.gov), which was scheduled to replace FDsys in December 2018 [1][3]. govinfo offers significantly enhanced functionality and took the place of FDsys when it was retired [3].

rows.question: How much did GPO procure in printing and information products in FY 2018 on behalf of federal agencies?
rows.answer: In FY 2018, GPO procured more than $375 million worth of printing and other information products on behalf of its Federal agency partners [2]. This work consisted of more than 84,000 specific orders fulfilled by thousands of private-sector vendors [2].

rows.question: How many copies of how many titles did GPO distribute to depository libraries in FY 2018?
rows.answer: In FY 2018, GPO distributed 802,834 copies of 4,211 titles to depository libraries nationwide [3][4].

rows.question: How many libraries participate in the Federal Depository Library Program?
rows.answer: 1,133 designated Federal depository libraries (or a network of 1,133 public, academic, law, and other libraries) participate in the Federal Depository Library Program [4][5].

rows.question: What were GPO's total revenues in FY 2018?
rows.answer: $874.5 million. GPO’s consolidated revenues (net of eliminations) totaled $874.5 million in fiscal 2018 and were primarily derived from Printing & Binding and Appropriations [2][3].

rows.question: How many passports did GPO produce in FY 2018?
rows.answer: In FY 2018, GPO produced 16 million passports for the State Department [2].

rows.question: Who signed the annual report as Acting Deputy Director?
rows.answer: JOHN W. CRAWFORD signed the annual report as Acting Deputy Director [1].

rows.answer: 34,367 titles, which was cataloged by staff by the end of FY 2018 [2][5].
